items.label: ✦Care Instructions
items.value: Wash in cold water,gentle cycle, do not wring,do not tumble dry,avoid direct sunlight,dry flat in shade.

items: ✦Soft Lightweight Knit Fabric - Crafted from premium, breathable knit material for all-day comfort. This 2026 trendy top is lightweight enough for summer days and soft enough for year-round wear.
✦Chic Hollow Out Stripe Design - Features elegant cap sleeves and classic scoop neck, accented with delicate eyelet stripes. Flatters all body types and adds a touch of sophistication to your outfit.

items.label: ✦4-Season Versatility & Easy Styling
items.value: Can be worn alone in summer or layered under blazers and cardigans in fall and winter. Easy to pair with high-waisted jeans, shorts, skirts or tailored pants. A must-have wardrobe staple, perfect for creating a polished work look or a casual vacation style in seconds.

items: ✦Effortless Occasion Transition - Seamlessly goes from office business casual, weekend brunches, and daily errands to beach vacations and cruise wear.
